I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent you the list in our DM:

- **#PD-4492**: from Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" digest, dated 5 Oct 2025 (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support fixed it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning's 04:00 shift checked in normally.
- **#4419**: from Moss's "North cheat sheet" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on the third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support to test the scanner firmware. The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell how current this one is.

I checked all six of Moss's notes in the shared folders, four for North and two for Central:

- **No ticket numbers:** Moss's other two North digests (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in) mention Quarrendon but don't give any.
- **Not Quarrendon:** the Central digest lists #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those are all for Marrow accounts.
- **Different company:** Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" isn't one of Moss's. It's about a company that isn't our customer, so I left it out.
